$comment: Which match servers this deployment offers, and the ONE file to edit when that changes — no rebuild. Each entry: an id (remembered as the player's pick, never shown), a short name (the lobby's region column), and the match server's host. Omit `host` for the server behind this page's own origin, which is the single-box deployment shipped here. The scheme is the page's, so name an authority and not a URL. See docs/multiplayer.md. Two regions look like: { "id": "us-west-1", "name": "US West", "host": "us-west-1.example.com" }, { "id": "us-east-1", "name": "US East", "host": "us-east-1.example.com" }
